Q=(0,0), S=(s,s), Z=(t+s,t), X=(t,t-s)。

method.method_draft: Use a dissection/area-cancellation route. From the image, split the shaded quadrilateral Q-S-Z-X by the visible sides QR and SR of square PQRS into three triangles: triangle QSR inside square PQRS, triangle SRZ on the right, and triangle QRX below. Let s be the side length of each square. Let h be the vertical distance from WZ down to QR. Because W lies on diagonal QS, the horizontal offset that makes Z extend to the right of SR is also h. Thus triangle SRZ has base SR=s and height h, so its area is sh/2. Since WX is a side of the congruent square of length s, X is s below W, so its distance below QR is s-h; triangle QRX has base QR=s and height s-h, so its area is s(s-h)/2. Triangle QSR is half of square PQRS, with area s^2/2. Therefore shaded area = s^2/2 + sh/2 + s(s-h)/2 = s^2. The shaded area is 1 cm^2, so area(PQRS)=s^2=1 cm^2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述: In the attached diagram, PQRS is the left square with PS horizontal, SR vertical, QR horizontal, and PQ vertical. WXYZ is a congruent square placed to the right/lower side, with WZ horizontal and parallel to PS. The shaded region is the quadrilateral with vertices Q, S, Z, and X. The visible sides QR and SR of square PQRS divide this shaded region into three pieces: triangle QSR inside PQRS, triangle SRZ on the right, and triangle QRX below. The point W is shown on the diagonal QS of square PQRS, and WX is a vertical side of the congruent square WXYZ. 推理: Let s be the common side length of the two congruent squares. Let h be the vertical distance from WZ down to QR. Since W lies on diagonal QS of square PQRS, the horizontal distance from W to the side SR equals the vertical distance from WZ to QR, namely h. Because WZ has length s, point Z extends h units to the right of SR. Thus triangle SRZ has base SR = s and height h, so its area is sh/2. Since WX is a side of WXYZ, WX = s, so X is s units below W. Because W is h units above QR, X is s - h units below QR. Therefore triangle QRX has base QR = s and height s - h, so its area is s(s - h)/2. Triangle QSR is half of square PQRS, so its area is s²/2. Therefore the shaded area is s²/2 + sh/2 + s(s - h)/2 = s²/2 + sh/2 + s²/2 - sh/2 = s². The shaded area is given as 1 cm², so s² = 1 cm². Hence the area of square PQRS is 1 cm².

Q=(0,0), S=(s,s), Z=(t+s,t), X=(t,t-s).
